final: SELECT t.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(CAST(s.gbsize AS REAL) / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON CAST(t.zoneregistry AS TEXT) = CAST(s.zoneref AS TEXT) WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY t.riskeval
